risks.title: Cutover step has no owner

evidence.quote: Switch the application to the new cluster

risks.scenario: Nobody answers when the cutover fails.
risks.mitigation: Name one owner for the switch step.

risks.title: Vendor is late

evidence.quote: The vendor will deliver on time

risks.scenario: The vendor delivers late and the migration slips.
risks.detection: No delivery confirmation a week before.
risks.mitigation: Ask the vendor for a date.

risks.title: Budget runs out
risks.scenario: The money runs out before the migration ends.
